import sys, json
from forge_factory.afo import runtime, dispatch
runs = runtime.fabro_view(50)
assert runs is not None, 'Fabro unreachable'
lab = [r for r in runs if isinstance(r.get('labels'), dict) and r['labels'].get('forge')]
kinds = sorted({dispatch.run_kind(r) for r in runs})
print(json.dumps({'runs': len(runs), 'with_forge_label': len(lab), 'lifecycle_kinds': kinds, 'sample_labels': lab[0]['labels'] if lab else None}))
sys.exit(0 if lab and all(k in ('RUNNABLE','RUNNING','SUCCEEDED','FAILED','CANCELLED') for k in kinds) else 1)
